name: 土地梁
The Shrine Beam
before: 村边一座小土地庙，屋脊上的大梁是十年前换的，换得极好，十年没漏过一滴雨。一伙雾海弩手爬上屋顶要拆梁：梁是上好的铁梨木，舰队要拿去做桅杆。土地公被他们挪到门外淋雨，老庙祝撑着伞，替土地公遮着。

A little earth-god shrine at the edge of the village, its ridge beam replaced ten years ago and replaced so well that not a drop has leaked since. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has climbed the roof to pull the beam out: it's fine ironwood, and the fleet wants it for a mast. They've moved the earth god outside into the rain, and the old shrine keeper stands holding an umbrella over him.
after: 弩手被赶下屋顶。梁底下刻着一只小船，旁边一行字：「千里号木作老榫修。屋不漏，船不漏。」老庙祝说那木匠换完梁，在庙里睡了一觉，醒来说，这是他上船以来睡得最踏实的一回。

The crossbowmen are chased off the roof. Carved on the underside of the beam is a little boat and a line of words: 'Mended by Old Tenon, carpenter of the Qianli. If the roof doesn't leak, the ship won't.' Once the beam was in, says the old keeper, the carpenter slept a night in the shrine and woke saying it was the soundest sleep he'd had since he went to sea.

name: 哼歌台
The Humming Stage
before: 村里的戏台被一大队雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手占了当营房，台上晾着号衣，台柱上拴着马。村里不许唱一支歌，谁家孩子唱，就罚谁家交米：那支歌是十年前从千里号上传下来的。孩子们就不唱，改成哼，哼得满村都是调子，水兵们听着听着，自己也哼起来了。

The village opera stage has been taken over as barracks by a large force of Fog Sea marines, crossbowmen and boarders, their uniforms drying on the boards, their horses tied to the pillars. One song is banned, and any family whose child sings it is fined in rice: the song came ashore from the Qianli ten years ago. So the children don't sing it. They hum it, until the whole village is full of the tune, and before long the marines are humming it too.
after: 水兵被赶走，孩子们爬上戏台，放开嗓子唱：「一程水，一程雾，三百盏灯走前路；回头看，后来人，灯不灭，路不孤。」教歌的是千里号上一个弹琵琶的水手，「他说是船主写的，要我们唱给后来的人听」。

The marines are driven off and the children climb onto the stage and sing out loud: 'A stretch of water, a stretch of fog, three hundred lamps go on ahead; look back, you who come after, the lamps stay lit, the road's not lonely.' A pipa-playing sailor from the Qianli taught it to them. 'He said the owner wrote it, and we should sing it for whoever came after.'

name: 名叫千里
A Boy Called Qianli
before: 一个九岁的男孩在田埂上飞跑，后面追着一伙雾海跳帮手，嚷嚷着要抓「千里」。男孩就叫千里，是村里铁匠的儿子。提督不许人提千里号，跳帮手便连人名也要管，非要他改叫「百里」。男孩边跑边回头骂：「我爹起的名，你们管不着！」

A nine-year-old boy races along the field banks with a gang of Fog Sea boarders behind him, yelling that they'll catch 'Qianli'. Qianli is the boy's name; he's the village blacksmith's son. The admiral won't have the Qianli spoken of, so the boarders mean to police names too and insist he be called Baili instead. The boy shouts back over his shoulder as he runs: 'My dad named me! It's none of your business!'
after: 跳帮手被赶跑，孩子他娘阿菱出来道谢，脸红了一下。十年前她和千里号上一个姓郑的水手好过，他说一年就回。她等了一年，嫁了铁匠，名字是铁匠起的：「他说那后生要是回来，看见这名字，也就不难过了。」

The boarders are chased off, and the boy's mother, A-Ling, comes out to thank you and blushes. Ten years ago she was sweet on a sailor from the Qianli named Zheng, who said he'd be back in a year. She waited a year and married the blacksmith, and it was the blacksmith who chose the name. 'He said if that young man ever comes back and hears it, it won't hurt him so much.'

name: 遗物仓
The Keepsake Store
before: 荒原上一座大仓，仓门贴着提督的封条，一大队雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手守在门口，比守粮仓还严。十年来，沿岸凡是跟千里号沾边的东西，都收进了这座仓：一只锅，一根针，一双草鞋，一面拨浪鼓。村里人都以为里头早烧光了，没人敢问。

A great storehouse on the moor sealed with the admiral's own seal, guarded by a large force of Fog Sea marines, crossbowmen and boarders, more tightly than any granary. For ten years everything along the coast with any tie to the Qianli has been collected into it: a pot, a needle, a pair of straw sandals, a rattle drum. The villagers assume it was all burned long ago, and no one dares ask.
after: 守兵败了，仓门打开，东西一件件摆得整整齐齐，每件都系着签：「千里号大厨老鼎之勺」「柳医之针」「水手郑某所赠拨浪鼓」。墙上贴着提督的手令：「此皆千里号遗物，存而勿毁，待其回。」

The guards are beaten and the doors opened. Everything inside is laid out in neat rows, each item tagged: 'Ladle of Old Ding, cook of the Qianli', 'Needle of Doctor Liu', 'Rattle drum given by the sailor Zheng'. On the wall hangs a handwritten order from the admiral: 'These are the Qianli's belongings. Keep them. Destroy nothing. Hold them until it returns.'

name: 举牌崖
Placard Cliff
before: 海边一处高崖，崖上的雾海弩手日夜盯着海对面的淡水岛。那是舰队的水源，谁的船靠近就射谁。岛上的人隔着海喊话也不许，只能在岸边举牌子。今天对岸举起的牌子上写着三个大字：「水又咸。」

A high cliff on the coast where Fog Sea crossbowmen watch Freshwater Isle across the strait day and night. It's the fleet's water source, and any boat that goes near gets shot at. The islanders aren't even allowed to shout across, so they hold up placards on the shore. Today's placard over there reads, in big characters: 'Water salty again.'
after: 弩手被赶下崖，对岸又换了一块牌子：「猫还在。」崖上的老哨兵说，岛上有只老猫谁也抓不住，舰上的人想抱它上船，被它挠了个满脸花。「它是千里号丢下的，岛上的人当它是宝。」

The crossbowmen are driven off the cliff, and across the water a new placard goes up: 'Cat still here.' There's an old cat on the island nobody can catch, says the old sentry; fleet men tried to carry it aboard and got their faces raked for it. 'The Qianli left it behind. The islanders treat it like treasure.'

name: 封千洞
The Sealed Qian Cave
before: 海边一处荒僻的石洞，洞口用大石封着，石上刻着一个「千」字。雾海水师派了一支精兵守了十年，不许开，也不许人靠近：谁也不知道里头是什么，提督说「不知道的，就守着」。洞前的水兵、弩手、跳帮手兵器擦得锃亮，等了十年，总算等来了一场仗。

A lonely cave on the shore, its mouth sealed with a great stone carved with the character Qian. The Fog Sea navy has kept a picked company on it for ten years, forbidden to open it or let anyone near. No one knows what's inside, and the admiral said, 'What we don't know, we guard.' The marines, crossbowmen and boarders before the cave have polished their weapons bright, and after ten years of waiting they finally have a fight.
after: 精兵败了，封石推开。洞里是一只备用大锚、两卷新帆、一盘锚缆，锚上挂着一块木牌，是船主沈渡的字：「回程用。若我们不回，给后来者用。」龚墨斗摸着帆布笑了：「后千里正缺一面帆。」

The picked company is beaten and the stone rolled back. Inside are a spare anchor, two rolls of new sail and a coil of anchor cable, and on the anchor hangs a wooden tag in the owner Shen Du's hand: 'For the voyage home. If we don't come back, for whoever comes after.' Gong Modou runs a hand over the canvas and laughs. 'Houqianli was just short a sail.'

name: 望猫礁
Cat-Watch Rock
before: 海边礁石上坐着个摆渡的老婆婆，船被雾海跳帮手扣了，只好天天坐在礁上看海。她说每年八月，海对面淡水岛上有只老猫，会跑到岛子最西头的石头上，蹲一整天，朝这边望。跳帮手说她疯了，要把她从礁上撵走，省得她「替千里号招魂」。

An old ferrywoman sits on the rocks by the sea; Fog Sea boarders have impounded her boat, so all she can do is sit and watch the water. Every eighth month, she says, an old cat on Freshwater Isle goes out to the westernmost rock and crouches there all day, looking this way. The boarders say she's mad and want her off the rocks before she 'calls up the Qianli's ghosts'.
after: 跳帮手被赶走，老婆婆的船也领回来了。她说十年前千里号在岛上取水，她渡过人，看见一只黄猫从船上跳下来，满船的人在后头喊「船长！船长！」它头也不回。猫叫「船长」，是因为它总睡在沈船主的椅子上。

The boarders are driven off and her boat returned. Ten years ago, when the Qianli was taking on water at the island, she was ferrying people and saw a ginger cat leap off the ship while the whole crew shouted after it, 'Captain! Captain!' It never looked back. They called the cat Captain because it always slept in Owner Shen's chair.

name: 渡簿棚
The Ferry Book Shed
before: 去淡水岛的渡口只此一处，渡口上一座竹棚，棚里挂着渡簿，过海的人都要登记。一伙雾海跳帮手占了渡口，所有的船都拴在他们的桩上，过海一趟交三斗米，交了还得等提督的批文，批文三个月来一回。

There is only one ferry landing for Freshwater Isle, with a bamboo shed on it where the ferry book hangs and every crossing is logged. A gang of Fog Sea boarders has taken the landing, with every boat tied to their posts. A crossing costs three dou of rice, and after paying you wait for the admiral's permit, which comes once every three months.
after: 跳帮手被赶走，渡船解了缆。老渡簿翻到十年前八月：「廿四日，千里号小艇六条往淡水岛取水，往返三日。领船者许，船主沈，水手若干，皆付渡钱。」底下一行：「猫一只，未付。」

The boarders are driven off and the ferries cast loose. The old ferry book, at the eighth month ten years ago: 'Twenty-fourth day. Six boats of the Qianli to Freshwater Isle for water, three days there and back. Pilot Xu, owner Shen, sailors various, all paid the fare.' One line below: 'One cat. Unpaid.'

name: 荔枝坡
Lychee Slope
before: 荒原尽头的坡上孤零零长着一棵荔枝树，在这片荒地上扎眼得很，树下围了一圈竹篱笆。一伙雾海弩手守着树，说这是舰队的树，每年结了果，一颗不少全送去旗舰。村里的孩子馋得在篱笆外头转，转一圈，咽一口口水。

At the moor's end a lone lychee tree grows on the slope, conspicuous on this bare ground, a bamboo fence around it. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen guards it as the fleet's tree; every year, every fruit goes to the flagship. The village children circle the fence in longing, swallowing at every lap.
after: 弩手被赶走，孩子们总算尝了一颗。树是千里号的水手种的，种的是泉州带来的荔枝核：「等它结果，我们就回来。」七年前它头一回结果，村里人摘下第一颗，拿盐腌着存在罐里，一年一颗，如今罐里有七颗。

The crossbowmen are driven off and the children finally get a taste. The tree was planted by the Qianli's sailors from a lychee stone brought from Quanzhou: 'When it fruits, we'll be back.' Seven years ago it fruited for the first time. The villagers picked the first lychee and put it down in salt in a jar, one each year since. There are seven in the jar now.

name: 朝天炮城
The Sky-Gun Fort
before: 一道山坳里修着一座石砌的小炮城，城里的炮口一律朝着天，不对海，也不对路。雾海水师最精的人马驻在这里，水兵守门，弩手上墙，跳帮手巡坳口。附近的人都说这里守的是千里号的东西，可千里号的什么东西要拿炮城来守，谁也说不上来。

A small stone gun fort sits in a fold of the hills, and all its guns point at the sky, not at the sea, not at the road. The Fog Sea navy's finest are posted here: marines on the gate, crossbowmen on the walls, boarders patrolling the mouth of the fold. Everyone nearby says it guards something of the Qianli's, though nobody can say what of the Qianli's would need a gun fort to guard it.
after: 炮城被打下。城里十二门铜炮不是水师的，炮身上铸着「千里」，是千里号卸在岸上的：卸了炮，船吃水浅，过得了浅滩。炮口塞着一张油纸：「千里号不与官船交火。沈渡。」提督把炮收了，炮口朝天，十年没舍得熔。

The fort falls. Its twelve bronze guns aren't the navy's; 'Qianli' is cast into their barrels. The Qianli unloaded them here: without the guns the ships drew less water and could clear the shallows. Stuffed in one muzzle is a sheet of oiled paper: 'The Qianli will not exchange fire with the emperor's ships. Shen Du.' The admiral took the guns, set them pointing at the sky, and in ten years never could bring himself to melt them down.

name: 水手画廊
The Sailors' Gallery
before: 村口一个画像的摊子，墙上挂着十几张人像，画得极像，连痣都点上了。画师说这些是十年前一群水手请他画的，要托人捎回泉州给家里，可船出不了雾海，画就一直挂着。一伙雾海弩手今天来收画像，说提督要「千里号遗物」，画师抱着画架不放。

A portrait painter's stall at the village gate, a dozen likenesses on the wall, so true he's even put in the moles. A group of sailors had them painted ten years ago, says the painter, to send home to Quanzhou, but no ship could get out of the Sea of Fog, so here they've hung. Today a gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has come to collect them, 'Qianli belongings' for the admiral, and the painter clings to his easel.
after: 弩手被赶走，画像一张张取下来：一个胖厨子，一个瘦郎中，一个弹琵琶的，一个最小的后生，眉眼像龙四海。最后一张是个黑脸汉子，眯着眼看海。阿汐一下子哭出了声：「是我爹。」画师把那张卷好，给了她。

The crossbowmen are driven off and the portraits come down one by one: a fat cook, a thin doctor, a pipa player, the youngest lad of all with Long Sihai's brows and eyes. The last is a dark-faced man squinting out to sea. Axi bursts into tears. 'That's my father.' The painter rolls it up and gives it to her.

name: 炮仗屋
The Firework Hut
before: 海边一座石头小屋，屋里码着一车烟花，拿油布裹得严严实实。看屋的老渔夫十年来每逢雨季都把油布换一层。一伙雾海弩手撬开了门，说烟花能做信号火箭，要运去舰上。老渔夫拿身子堵着门：「这是人家订的，钱都付了！」

A little stone hut by the sea with a cartload of fireworks stacked inside, wrapped tight in oilcloth. The old fisherman who minds it has changed the oilcloth every rainy season for ten years. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has broken the door in; fireworks make good signal rockets, they say, and these are going to the fleet. The old man blocks the doorway with his body: 'Those were ordered! They're paid for!'
after: 弩手被赶走，老渔夫把油布重新裹好。烟花是千里号的水手们凑钱买的：「回来那天，在岸上放。」他说放烟花得有两个人，一个点，一个看。「我替他们看着这车炮仗。他们回来，我替他们点。」

The crossbowmen are chased off and the old man wraps the oilcloth back on. The Qianli's sailors pooled their money for these fireworks: 'For the day we're back. Set them off on the shore.' Fireworks take two people, he says, one to light and one to watch. 'I'm minding this cartload for them. When they're back, I'll do the lighting.'

name: 称人秤
The People Scale
before: 海边一座米铺，铺前吊着一杆大秤，能称三百斤。一队雾海水兵要把秤扛走，说舰上分粮要用。米铺老板抱着秤杆不撒手，秤砣砸了自己的脚，疼得直蹦，嘴里还喊：「秤可以借，秤簿不能拿！」

A rice shop by the sea with a great steelyard hanging out front that can weigh three hundred jin. A squad of Fog Sea marines wants to carry it off for dividing rations aboard ship. The shopkeeper hugs the beam and won't let go; the counterweight drops on his foot and he hops about in pain, still shouting, 'Borrow the scale if you must, but not the book!'
after: 水兵被赶走，老板翻开秤簿：十年前千里号的人临走，一个个上秤称了一回，说回来再称，看谁瘦了。三百个名字，三百个斤两。阿汐在中间找到一行：「领港许潮生，一百二十八斤。」她笑着抹眼泪：「回来得给他多吃点。」

The marines are driven off and the shopkeeper opens the scale book. Before they left, every one of the Qianli's people got on the scale, saying they'd weigh again on the way back and see who'd got thin. Three hundred names, three hundred weights. Halfway down Axi finds one line: 'Pilot Xu Chaosheng, one hundred and twenty-eight jin.' She laughs and wipes her eyes. 'We'll have to feed him up when he's back.'

name: 猫引沙脊
The Cat's Sandbar
before: 海边望得见淡水岛，岛和岸之间隔着一道海峡，只有大退潮时才露出一线沙脊。一伙雾海跳帮手守在沙脊这头，见人就赶，可他们自己也不知道沙脊怎么走，下去过的好几个都陷进了流沙。潮退了，雾里，一只黄猫正沿着沙脊一步一步朝这边走来。

Freshwater Isle is in sight from the shore, a strait between, and only at the lowest tides does a thin ridge of sand show above the water. A gang of Fog Sea boarders holds this end of the ridge and chases everyone off, though they don't know how to walk it themselves; several who tried sank in quicksand. The tide is out, and through the fog a ginger cat is picking its way along the ridge toward you, step by step.
after: 跳帮手被赶走。黄猫走到跟前，闻了闻后千里的灯笼，转身往回走，走几步回头看一眼。你们踩着它的脚印过了沙脊，一步没陷。小桨说：「它认得这盏灯。」猫的左耳缺了一块，正是那只叫「船长」的猫。

The boarders are driven off. The ginger cat comes right up, sniffs Houqianli's lanterns, turns and heads back, glancing over its shoulder every few steps. You cross the ridge in its pawprints and not one foot sinks. 'It knows this lantern,' says Xiaojiang. A piece is missing from its left ear. It's the cat they called Captain.

name: 箍桶铺
The Cooperage
before: 海边一座箍桶铺，铺里堆满了水桶，大的能装下一个人，小的只装一碗。一伙雾海跳帮手逼着老桶匠给舰队赶桶，说岛上的水不够装，桶多了水就多了。老桶匠一边箍一边嘟囔：「桶多了水就多？那我箍个海出来给你们！」

A cooperage by the sea crammed with water casks, from ones big enough to hold a man to ones that hold a bowl. A gang of Fog Sea boarders is making the old cooper turn out casks for the fleet: there isn't enough water on the island to fill what they've got, they say, so more casks will mean more water. The cooper mutters as he hammers a hoop: 'More casks, more water? Shall I hoop you up a sea while I'm at it?'
after: 跳帮手被赶跑，老桶匠才说起旧事：十年前千里号在他这儿订了三百零一只桶，一人一只，多一只。他问多的那只给谁，沈船主说：「给后来的人。」那只桶装满了水，留在了岛上。

The boarders are chased off and only then does the cooper tell you: ten years ago the Qianli ordered three hundred and one casks from him, one per head and one over. He asked who the extra was for. 'For whoever comes after,' Owner Shen said. That cask was filled with water and left on the island.

name: 采珠湾
Pearl Divers' Bay
before: 一道清水湾里漂着几条采珠船，船上的女人腰系石坠，一头扎下去，半天才冒上来。可如今她们捞的不是蚌，是炮：舰队沉在湾里的铁炮，雾海弩手逼她们一门门捞上来，换米。珠子一颗也没捞，珠商来了好几趟，空着手走。

A few pearling boats float in a clear bay, the women aboard tying stone weights round their waists and diving, staying down a long time before they surface. But these days it isn't oysters they bring up. It's cannon, the fleet's iron guns sunk in the bay, which Fog Sea crossbowmen make them haul up one by one to trade for rice. Not a single pearl has been brought up, and the pearl merchants have come and gone empty-handed.
after: 弩手被赶走，采珠女们又捞起了蚌，佩服你们，拿珠子跟你们换货。领头的阿嬷说，舰上缺铁缺得厉害，连沉炮都要捞，岛群那边的军市上，水兵拿锚链换米，「铁吃光了，船就只剩木头了」。

The crossbowmen are driven off and the divers go back to oysters, and in admiration they trade pearls with you. The fleet is so short of iron, says the old woman who leads them, that it fishes up its own sunken guns. Out among the islands, at the navy market, sailors trade anchor chain for rice. 'When the iron's all eaten, the ships will be nothing but wood.'

name: 千里堤
Qianli Dyke
before: 淡水岛是一座白沙岛，岛上没有一块石头，渔村全靠一道石堤挡浪。堤是十年前垒的，这些年被浪掏得七零八落。岛上的人从前拿鱼干跟过往的船换压舱石，可舰队不许船靠岛，石头断了来路。码头上守着一队雾海弩手，见了你们的船，弩都端了起来。岛上的人在后头举着牌子：「有石头吗？」

Freshwater Isle is an island of white sand without a single stone on it, and its fishing village relies on one stone dyke to break the waves. The dyke was built ten years ago, and the surf has been tearing gaps in it ever since. The islanders used to trade dried fish to passing ships for ballast stones, but the fleet lets no ship land, and the stones stopped coming. A squad of Fog Sea crossbowmen holds the jetty and raises its crossbows at the sight of your ship. Behind them, the islanders hold up a placard: 'Got any stones?'
after: 弩手被赶走，后千里卸下压舱石，岛上的人拿鱼和芋头来换，石头换粮食的买卖又开张了。阿汐抓起一把岛上的沙，细看全是碎贝壳和珊瑚屑：这岛是海里的活物堆起来的，沙子白，软，垒不成墙。村长指着那道旧堤：「这是千里号的石头。那年他们取水，要腾出地方装水桶，把三百块压舱石卸给了我们，一块没要钱。」从此这道堤就叫千里堤。

The crossbowmen are driven off. Houqianli unloads her ballast stones, the islanders bring fish and taro in exchange, and the trade of stone for food is open again. Axi scoops up a handful of the island's sand: look closely and it's all broken shell and coral. This island was heaped up by living things in the sea, and its sand is white and soft and won't build a wall. The headman points at the old dyke. 'Those are the Qianli's stones. The year they came for water, they needed room for the casks, so they unloaded three hundred ballast stones to us and wouldn't take a copper.' Ever since, it's been called Qianli Dyke.

name: 镇雾旧舰
The Old Zhenwu
before: 海岸背后一处避风的山坳里，搁着一条拆了桅的旧战船，船头还挂着「镇雾」的牌子，是提督十年前的旗舰，撞坏了船头，拖上岸做了军械库。雾海水师留了最精的一队人马守着它，水兵把舱口，弩手站船楼，跳帮手在船底下巡。船尾的舵楼门锁着，谁也不许上去。

In a sheltered fold behind the coast lies an old warship with her masts struck, a 'Zhenwu' nameboard still on her bow: the admiral's flagship ten years ago, her bow stove in, hauled ashore and made an armoury. The Fog Sea navy keeps its finest company on her, marines at the hatches, crossbowmen on the forecastle, boarders patrolling beneath her keel. The door of the stern cabin is locked, and no one may go up.
after: 精兵败了。舵楼里挂着旧航海日志，最后一页：「八月廿八，暖水口截千里号。六号横撞，舰首破，截获空船一。五船入雾，雾中现楼台，不见。依令不得越雾，止。」底下一行，墨迹透了纸：「她回头喊了一句。我听见了。」

The picked company is beaten. In the stern cabin hangs the old log, and its last page reads: 'Twenty-eighth of the eighth month. Intercepted the Qianli at the Warm Gate. Number Six rammed broadside, our bow stove in; one empty ship taken. Five ships into the fog; towers appeared in it; gone. Orders forbid passing beyond the fog. Halted.' One line below, the ink pressed through the page: 'She called something back over her shoulder. I heard it.'

name: 后来泉
The After-Comers' Spring
before: 淡水岛中间一口泉，泉边立着一块旧木牌，字是刻的：「千里号取水于此，余水留后来者。」泉水清，可这两年越来越咸。一伙雾海跳帮手占着泉眼，日夜拿大桶往舰上运，一刻不停，泉边还摆着一只封着口的老水桶，谁也搬不动它，因为每回有人去搬，一只缺耳朵的黄猫就扑上来。

In the middle of Freshwater Isle is a spring, and beside it an old carved board: 'The Qianli drew water here. What is left is for those who come after.' The water is clear, but these last two years it has turned saltier and saltier. A gang of Fog Sea boarders holds the spring and ships it to the fleet by the barrel day and night, without pause. Beside the spring stands an old sealed cask nobody can move, because whenever someone tries, a ginger cat with a torn ear flies at him.
after: 跳帮手被赶走。老人说，岛下的淡水是雨水攒下的，比海水轻，像一层油浮在咸水上；舀狠了，咸水就顶上来。千里号只取够用的，舰队十年不停地抽。那只老桶是千里号的第三百零一只，写着「后来者」。猫跳上桶盖不走了。

The boarders are driven off. The fresh water under the island, the old people say, is rain gathered in the sand; it's lighter than seawater and floats on the salt like a layer of oil. Draw too hard and the salt pushes up from below. The Qianli took only what it needed; the fleet has pumped without stopping for ten years. The old cask is the Qianli's three hundred and first, marked 'For those who come after'. The cat jumps onto its lid, and stays.
first: 泉边抄出跳帮手囤的八十只空桶、两袋米、一筐咸鱼，还有一张舰队的取水令，上面写着「每日一百桶，不得少」。
At the spring you find the boarders' hoard: eighty empty casks, two sacks of rice, a basket of salt fish, and the fleet's water order: 'One hundred casks a day, not one fewer.'
pass: 每次路过，岛上的人都按千里号的老规矩，给你们打够用的水，一桶不多，再拿一串烤鱼，喂猫一条，给你们一条。
Every time you pass, the islanders draw you just enough water, by the Qianli's old rule, not a cask more, and bring a string of grilled fish: one for the cat, one for you.

name: 快艇岬
Fast Boat Point
before: 淡水岛东头一道石岬，岬下拴着几十条快艇，艇头装着铁钩，是雾海跳帮手跳帮用的。望见后千里从岛后绕出来，岬上一声锣响，快艇像一群梭子鱼扑了过来，钩子先上，人随后到，一气呵成，十年的操练没白练。

A rocky point at the east end of Freshwater Isle with dozens of fast boats tied below it, iron hooks on their bows: the Fog Sea boarders' craft. As Houqianli rounds the island, a gong sounds on the point, and the boats dart out like a shoal of barracuda, hooks first, men right behind, all in one smooth rush. Ten years of drilling have not gone to waste.
after: 快艇被一条条打退，跳帮头目被你们拎上了甲板。他倒也爽快，掏出军令给你们看：「凡挂千字灯者截之，生擒，不许伤一人。」他说十年来这条令一个字没改过，「提督是个死心眼，可他的心眼，不坏」。

The fast boats are beaten off one by one and the boarders' chief is hauled up onto your deck. He's frank about it and shows you his orders: 'Any ship showing Qian lanterns is to be stopped. Take them alive. Harm no one.' In ten years, he says, not a word of it has changed. 'The admiral's as stubborn as they come. But it's not a bad stubbornness.'

name: 迎截岛
Welcome-and-Stop Isle
before: 第二座岛的岸边排着一列哨船，哨船上的雾海跳帮手看清了后千里桅上那三百盏千字灯，一下子乱了套：有人往天上放响箭报警，有人往海里扔缆绳要迎船，有人举着钩子要跳帮，还有个老水兵跪在船头哭：「回来了，千里号回来了！」三拨人在一条船上推推搡搡，缆绳和钩子一齐朝你们飞了过来。

A line of picket boats waits along the shore of the second island, and when the Fog Sea boarders aboard make out the three hundred Qian lanterns on Houqianli's masts, they fall into chaos. Some fire whistling arrows to raise the alarm, some throw lines into the sea to welcome the ship in, some raise their hooks to board, and one old sailor kneels in the bow weeping, 'It's back, the Qianli's back!' Three factions shove each other about in the same boat, and lines and hooks come flying at you together.
after: 哨船被打散，那个跪着的老水兵扒着船舷看清了船尾的字，愣了半天：「后千里……不是它。」他的表弟当年在千里号上烧火。哨长派快艇去报旗舰：「非千里号，乃后千里。」回令很快到了，只有一句：「挂千字灯者，截。」

The pickets are scattered, and the old sailor who knelt hangs over the rail until he can read the name on your stern. A long silence. 'Houqianli... It isn't her.' His cousin was a stoker on the Qianli. The picket captain sends a boat to the flagship: 'Not the Qianli. The Houqianli.' The reply comes quickly, and it is one line: 'Any ship showing Qian lanterns: stop it.'

name: 水师菜园
The Navy's Garden
before: 岛背风的一面开着一片菜园，番薯、芥菜、葱，一垄垄排得整整齐齐，是雾海水师的老兵种的，十年来全靠它给舰上添一口青。可管园子的是个铁算盘似的军需官，带着一伙跳帮手，把菜一棵棵点了数锁进仓里，种菜的老兵自己偷吃一片叶子都要挨鞭子。

On the island's lee side lies a vegetable garden, sweet potatoes, mustard greens and spring onions in tidy rows, planted by old Fog Sea navy hands, and for ten years it has been the fleet's only source of anything green. But the man in charge is a quartermaster tight as a counting frame, who with a gang of boarders counts every plant and locks it in the store; an old gardener caught eating a single leaf gets the whip.
after: 军需官被捆了，仓门打开，种菜的老兵们头一回吃上了自己种的菜。一个老兵捧着一碗芥菜汤说：「提督每回上岛，都蹲在地头拔草，拔完了只说一句：明年多种点，万一他们回来，船上人多。」

The quartermaster is tied up and the store thrown open, and the old gardeners eat what they've grown for the first time. One of them, cradling a bowl of mustard-green soup, says, 'Every time the admiral comes to the island he squats in the rows pulling weeds, and when he's done he says just one thing: plant more next year. If they come back, there'll be more mouths aboard.'
first: 仓里抄出军需官锁着的三百斤番薯、二十捆芥菜、一缸腌葱，还有一本菜账，记到了每一片叶子。

In the store you find what the quartermaster had under lock: three hundred jin of sweet potatoes, twenty bundles of mustard greens, a crock of pickled onions, and a vegetable ledger that accounts for every single leaf.
pass: 每次路过，老兵们都往你们船上扔几捆刚拔的菜，带着泥：「吃青的，牙不松。」
Every time you pass, the old soldiers toss a few bundles of freshly pulled greens onto your deck, soil still on them. 'Eat your greens and your teeth won't loosen.'

name: 锚链市
Anchor-Chain Market
before: 第三座岛的海湾里，舰队的船围成一圈，船与船之间搭着跳板，就是雾海水师的军市。卖的不是货，是船本身：锚、锚链、铁钉、炮子、舵上的铁箍，一样样拆下来，跟岛上的渔户换米。今天一伙雾海弩手把市口封了，说提督有令，后千里一到，军市关门。拆了一半的锚链堆在跳板上，没人敢动。

In the bay of the third island the fleet's ships lie in a ring, gangplanks between them: the Fog Sea navy's market. What's for sale isn't goods but the ships themselves, anchors, anchor chain, nails, cannonballs, the iron bands off rudders, stripped piece by piece and traded to the islanders for rice. Today a gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has sealed the market's entrance: the admiral's orders, the market closes when Houqianli arrives. Half-stripped chain lies on the gangplanks and nobody dares touch it.
after: 弩手被赶走，军市重开，舰上拆下的铁换岛上的粮，你们也添了一份米进去。军需官叹着气说，朝廷十年没发饷，提督第一个拆的是自己船上的东西：先卖了佩刀的刀镡，再卖了船上的铜钟，「他说，令是他接的，饿也得先饿他」。老兵们指着最大的那条船，船头三盏灯并排挂着：镇雾号，提督就在上面。

The crossbowmen are driven off and the market reopens, iron from the ships for grain from the islands, and you put in a share of rice yourselves. The quartermaster sighs. The court hasn't paid in ten years, and the first thing the admiral stripped was his own: first he sold the guard off his sword, then the bronze bell from his ship. 'He said the order was given to him, so he'd be the first to go hungry.' The old hands point to the biggest ship in the ring, three lamps hanging side by side on her bow: the Zhenwu, and the admiral is aboard.

name: 网寮村
Net Shed Village
before: 第二座岛北头一个小渔村，家家门口晒着网，屋顶压着贝壳。可这一年的鱼一条都没进过自家锅：舰队按船抽鱼，一船抽九成，雾海水兵就住在村里看着，连鱼鳞都要刮下来带走。村里的老渔婆说，宁可不打鱼，也不白给，干脆把船都拖上了岸。

A little fishing village at the north end of the second island, nets drying at every door, shells weighting the roofs. This year not one fish has gone into a village pot: the fleet levies nine-tenths of every boat's catch, and Fog Sea marines live in the village to watch, scraping off even the scales to take away. Rather than give it away for nothing, says the village's old fishwife, they'd sooner not fish at all, and they've dragged every boat up the beach.
after: 水兵被赶走，船推下了水，渔婆佩服你们，开了晒场跟你们换货。她说每年八月廿八，提督都把镇雾号开到最东头那座岛外面，停在雾跟前，一停一整夜，天亮再开回来。「他是去那条线上站岗，」她说，「站了十年。」

The marines are driven off and the boats pushed back into the water, and the old fishwife, impressed, opens her drying yard to trade with you. Every twenty-eighth of the eighth month, she says, the admiral takes the Zhenwu out past the easternmost island and stops at the edge of the fog and sits there all night, and comes back at dawn. 'He goes to stand guard on that line,' she says. 'Ten years he's stood there.'

name: 鲛人礁
Merrow Reef
before: 岛南一片黑礁，寸草不生。夜里雾中飘来歌声，女人的嗓子，软软的，像哄孩子睡觉，唱的是泉州话。舰上的人拿蜡封耳朵，雾海弩手守在礁前，谁往歌声那边划就射谁。你们泊在礁外，歌声一句句飘过来，阿汐靠着船舷，眼皮发沉。小桨侧耳听了一会儿，脸一下子白了：「她在点名。」歌里一句一个人名，最后一句是「阿汐」。

South of the island lies a black reef where nothing grows. At night a song drifts out of the fog, a woman's voice, soft, like someone singing a child to sleep, in Quanzhou dialect. The fleet's men stop their ears with wax, and Fog Sea crossbowmen guard the reef and shoot anyone who rows toward the singing. You anchor off the reef and the song comes over line by line. Axi leans on the rail, her eyelids growing heavy. Xiaojiang cocks his head, listens a while, and goes white. 'She's calling a roll.' Each line of the song is a name. The last line is 'Axi'.
after: 弩手败了。礁上一个人也没有，只有一排排浪蚀的孔，潮一进一出，孔里就呜呜地响。阿汐听了很久：这是她爹哄她睡觉的歌，每晚唱一遍船上人的名字，最后一句是她。「可这首歌，除了我爹，没人会唱。」雾里的歌声停了。

The crossbowmen are beaten. There's no one on the reef at all, only rows of wave-worn holes that moan as the tide breathes in and out. Axi listens a long time. It's the song her father sang her to sleep with: every night the names of the people on the ship, and the last line was her. 'But nobody knows this song except my father.' Out in the fog, the singing stops.

name: 鲨鳍湾
Shark Fin Lagoon
before: 第三座岛西头一道礁湖，水是绿的，湖面上却竖着一片三角背鳍，来回打转。鲨鱼跟着舰队来的：舰上倒下的鱼骨、剩饭，十年里把它们一年年引到这里。渔户不敢下网，水兵也不敢下水洗澡，连跳帮手的快艇都绕着走。今天又有一条小渔船翻在湖口，渔夫骑在船底上大喊救命。

A reef lagoon at the west end of the third island, the water green, and on its surface a crowd of triangular fins circling. The sharks came with the fleet: ten years of fish bones and slops dumped overboard have drawn them here year after year. The fishers dare not cast a net, the marines dare not bathe, and even the boarders' fast boats go round. Today another little fishing boat has capsized at the lagoon's mouth, and the fisherman sits astride the upturned hull shouting for help.
after: 渔夫救上来了，这一回的鲨群被赶出了礁湖，湖面清净了几天。可舰队还泊在湖外，鱼骨剩饭一天不断，鲨鱼就一季一季地回来。岛上的人说，等舰队哪天开走了，这片湖才算真清净；在那之前，隔些日子就得来赶一回。

The fisherman is pulled out, this pack of sharks is driven from the lagoon, and the water is quiet for a few days. But the fleet is still anchored outside, and as long as the bones and slops keep coming, the sharks will be back season after season. The islanders say the lagoon will only truly be clear the day the fleet sails away; until then, someone has to come and drive them off every so often.

name: 截令碑
The Order Stele
before: 第三座岛的高处立着一块青石碑，碑上刻着一道军令，字有碗口大。碑前站着一队雾海水兵，衣甲破旧却站得笔直，是提督的仪仗，十年来每天在碑前换一回岗。碑的背面刻满了人名，一排一排，越往下字越新。水兵们看见你们走上来，齐刷刷挺起了枪。

On the third island's high ground stands a stele of grey stone with a military order carved on it in characters as big as bowls. Before it stands a squad of Fog Sea marines in worn-out armour, ramrod straight, the admiral's honour guard, who have changed the watch before the stele every day for ten years. The back of the stone is covered in names, row upon row, newer the further down. As you climb toward them the marines bring up their spears as one.
after: 仪仗被打散。碑文是十年前的兵部令：「千里号若入雾海，截之，勿令东去。截于雾海之内，不得越雾。」为什么要截，一个字没提。碑背是十年里撞礁死去的水兵。领头的水兵说：「提督也不知道为什么，只知道令没撤。」

The honour guard is scattered. The inscription is a Ministry of War order from ten years ago: 'If the Qianli enters the Sea of Fog, stop it. Let it not go east. Interception within the Sea of Fog. Do not pass beyond the fog.' Why, it doesn't say. The names on the back are ten years of sailors lost on the rocks. 'The admiral doesn't know why either,' says the leader of the guard. 'He only knows the order hasn't been lifted.'

name: 最后一道桩
The Last Stake Line
before: 最东头那座岛的海滩上打着一排木桩，桩顶削尖，桩后蹲着旗舰的雾海水兵，个个瘦得颧骨突出，号衣补了又补，可枪擦得发亮。再往东就是镇雾号的锚地。他们早听说后千里一路打过来，领头的什长把枪往沙里一顿：「你们打得过外头的，那是外头的本事。这一道，是提督的。」

A row of stakes is driven into the beach of the easternmost island, points sharpened, and behind them crouch the flagship's Fog Sea marines, cheekbones jutting with hunger, uniforms patched and patched again, spears polished bright. Beyond lies the Zhenwu's anchorage. They've heard how Houqianli fought its way here. Their sergeant grounds his spear in the sand. 'You beat the ones out there, that's to your credit. This line is the admiral's.'
after: 桩子被拔倒，水兵们坐在沙滩上喘气，没人逃。什长把水囊递给你们，说他家在泉州，十年没回去了，儿子该比他高了。「打了你们这一仗，心里倒松快了，」他望着锚地，「提督今晚也睡不着了。」

The stakes are torn down and the marines sit gasping on the sand. Not one runs. The sergeant passes you his water skin. His family is in Quanzhou, he says; he hasn't been home in ten years, and his son must be taller than him by now. 'Funny. Losing this fight's taken a weight off me.' He looks toward the anchorage. 'The admiral won't sleep tonight either.'

name: 芦花鸡舍
The Speckled Hen-House
before: 最东头那座岛上有座伙房，给旗舰做饭，伙房边搭着鸡舍，舍里那只最响的芦花大公鸡，就是号手当年从雾岸抱上船的。伙房被一伙雾海弩手把着，他们奉了令：后千里来了，一粒米、一个蛋都不许落进外人手里。公鸡天天照常打鸣，弩手嫌吵，正商量着炖了它。

The easternmost island has a galley that cooks for the flagship, and beside it a hen-house, home to the loudest bird of all, the big speckled rooster the bugler carried aboard from the Fog Coast. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen holds the galley under orders: now Houqianli is here, not a grain of rice or a single egg is to fall into outsiders' hands. The rooster goes on crowing every day as usual, and the crossbowmen, sick of the noise, are discussing stewing it.
after: 弩手被赶走，公鸡跳上伙房顶，冲着锚地打了一声长鸣。伙夫说，号手每天早上来喂它，喂完就站在船头，往西看。「鸡在，人就在。」他舀了一大碗米饭给你们：「明天打完仗，不管谁赢，都得吃饭。」

The crossbowmen are driven off and the rooster jumps onto the galley roof and crows long and loud toward the anchorage. Every morning, says the cook, the bugler comes to feed it, and then he stands in the bow looking west. 'Rooster's here, so's the man.' He ladles you a big bowl of rice. 'Whoever wins tomorrow, everyone's still got to eat.'
first: 伙房里抄出弩手看着的四十只鸡蛋、六袋米、一坛虾油，还有一摞军饼，饼上刻着「号手的，不要芝麻」。
In the galley you find what the crossbowmen were guarding: forty eggs, six sacks of rice, a crock of shrimp oil, and a stack of hardtack stamped 'Bugler's. No sesame.'
pass: 每次路过，伙夫都塞给你们一篮热乎乎的鸡蛋，公鸡站在屋顶上替你们报时辰。
Every time you pass, the cook gives you a basket of eggs still warm, and the rooster calls the hour for you from the roof.

name: 望锚坡
Anchorage Lookout
before: 岛顶一道土坡，往下望就是镇雾号：一条打了无数补丁的大战船，帆是旧的，锚链少了一半，船头三盏灯并排挂着。坡上扎着旗舰的一队雾海跳帮手，是提督派来盯着你们的。夜里，你们看见镇雾号的船头站着一个吹海螺的人，往西吹着一支泉州的南音。阿汐、小桨、戚小满都站到了船头。

From a ridge on the island's summit you can look straight down on the Zhenwu: a great warship patched past counting, her sails old, half her anchor chain gone, three lamps hung side by side on her bow. A company of the flagship's Fog Sea boarders is camped on the ridge, sent by the admiral to keep an eye on you. That night you see a man standing in the Zhenwu's bow blowing a conch westward, a Quanzhou nanyin tune. Axi, Xiaojiang and Qi Xiaoman all come up to Houqianli's bow.
after: 跳帮手被赶下坡。天亮前镇雾号放来一条小艇，传提督一句话：「辰时，镇雾号前。挂千字灯者，截。」你们把一路带来的东西摆上甲板：戚家的灯语被、阿舟的信、鲍老针的竹筒、铜炮里的那张油纸。阿汐点亮了三百盏灯。

The boarders are driven off the ridge. Before dawn the Zhenwu sends a boat with one line from the admiral: 'The hour of the dragon, before the Zhenwu. Any ship showing Qian lanterns will be stopped.' You carry up onto the deck everything you've brought this far: the Qi family's signal quilt, Azhou's letters, Bao Laozhen's bamboo tube, the oiled paper from the bronze gun. Axi lights the three hundred lanterns.

name: 镇雾号
The Zhenwu
before: 辰时，雾薄了一层。镇雾号横在雾海的最后一道线上，左右两翼排开水师仅剩的战船，水兵守舷，弩手上桅，跳帮手的快艇挂在船腹。船头站着雾海提督岑定波，五十来岁，两鬓全白，号衣洗得发灰，手里一只竹筒，装着十年前那道令。他看了后千里很久，看那三百盏灯，看灯下的人。「你们不是千里号，我知道。可令上写的是挂千字灯者截。我等了十年，令没撤，我不能先撤。」他举起手。「来吧。打过我，才算我截过了。」

At the hour of the dragon the fog thins by one layer. The Zhenwu lies broadside across the last line of the Sea of Fog, the navy's remaining warships drawn up on either wing, marines along the rails, crossbowmen in the tops, the boarders' fast boats slung at her sides. In her bow stands Cen Dingbo, Admiral of the Sea of Fog, fifty or so, his temples white, his uniform washed to grey, holding a bamboo tube with the order of ten years ago inside. He looks at Houqianli a long time, at the three hundred lanterns, at the people beneath them. 'You are not the Qianli. I know that. But the order says any ship showing Qian lanterns is to be stopped. I've waited ten years. The order has not been lifted, and I won't lift it first.' He raises his hand. 'Come. Beat me, and I'll count it as having tried to stop you.'
after: 镇雾号的帆落了。岑定波坐在甲板上，把竹筒放在膝头，没有打开。号手队里走出一个年轻人，左臂刺着一根系船柱：阿舟。他接过母亲的信，读了两行就蹲下了。岑定波说：「那夜沈渡回头喊了一句：『告诉后来的人，我在蜃楼等。』我听见了，令上说不得越雾，我就在这条线上站了十年。」他指向东南，雾正裂开一线，雾后隐约有楼台。「后千里不是千里号。我截的是千里号，没截过你们。去吧。」远处的雾岸上，北岬的灯三明一暗，打了三遍。

The Zhenwu's sails come down. Cen Dingbo sits on the deck with the bamboo tube on his knees, unopened. From the ranks of buglers steps a young man with a mooring bollard tattooed on his left forearm: Azhou. He takes his mother's letter, reads two lines and crouches down. Cen Dingbo speaks. 'That night Shen Du called back over her shoulder: “Tell whoever comes after, I'll wait in the Mirage.” I heard it. The order said not to pass beyond the fog, so I've stood on this line for ten years.' He points south-east, where the fog is parting in a crack and towers show faintly behind it. 'Houqianli isn't the Qianli. It was the Qianli I was ordered to stop. I never stopped you. Go.' Far behind on the Fog Coast, the north cape light flashes three bright, one dark, three times over.
